acceptanceCriteria.evidence: JSON round-trips via insert_pending/move_to_published unchanged (pending_articles_repo NOT modified). Integration AC2 carry-through test exercises move_to_published and asserts pairs/series survive into published_articles.model_fingerprint (tech-spec Testing 'AC2 carry-through').

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC3 — distinctive pair match over 30 days, ANY source → hard block: not in pending, link → processed_news, INFO log, [E015] with matched pair + earlier link
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: _pair_rule_verdict returns ('block',match) on a shared |D pair (news_bot.py:1025-1028); job() handles block → logger.info + mark_processed(link→processed_news) + alert_cross_source_blocked([E015], pairs=match.pairs) + continue/skip-publish (news_bot.py:2302-2324). Any-source: no same-source skip in the pair loop. Tests: test_distinctive_pair_cross_source_blocks, test_within_source_distinctive_pair_blocks, test_hard_block_path, admin test_e015_blocked_renders_matched_pairs. Smoke: 3 SDCC titles → shares_pair any_distinctive=True.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC4 — broad/theme-only match → soft flag: article PUBLISHES, operator gets [E014] (rate-limited); never a hard block on a broad key
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: flag verdict is TERMINAL and does NOT continue → article publishes; E014 gated by is_pair_rate_limited (news_bot.py:2326-2352). Theme-only key is always '*|<series>|B' (broad) regardless of the series tier (_build_pairs:466-467). Tests: test_broad_pair_soft_flag_is_terminal (asserts one verdict/ping, no [E015] after), test_soft_flag_path, test_theme_only_pop_culture_flags_no_model, test_soft_flag_rate_limited, admin test_e014_broad_series_flag.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC5 — composition 'in addition': when the pair rule does NOT hard-block (no match / no series / toggle off) the legacy set-overlap dedup (≥50%, 7d) always backstops, unchanged
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: _check_cross_source_dedup runs _set_overlap_backstop_verdict only on a pair-rule 'pass' (news_bot.py:1144-1166); block/flag are terminal. Backstop is cross-source-only, 7-day subset derived from the single 30-day fetch. Tests: test_pair_pass_falls_through_to_backstop_block (positive — backstop actually BLOCKS, not vacuous), test_backstop_includes_candidate_within_7_days, test_backstop_excludes_candidate_older_than_7_days, test_pass_through_with_non_empty_fp.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC6 — env toggle enables/disables the pair rule; default ON; read at startup; OFF → rule fully skipped, only legacy dedup
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: DEDUP_SERIES_ENABLED import-time const, same pattern as DB_FILE/TZ (news_bot.py:130-132); gate reads the module attribute (monkeypatchable). Off → 'if DEDUP_SERIES_ENABLED and pairs' short-circuits the pair rule. Toggle-parse smoke: unset/'1'/blank → True; '0'/'false'/'no'/'off' (any case) → False. Test: test_toggle_off_skips_pair_rule.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC7 — theme coverage: HW car-lines + events (SDCC) + franchises (Stranger Things, Top Gun, K-Pop Demon Hunters); item without a model → theme-key (broad only); unknown/untagged series → broad tier (fail-safe)
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: SERIES_LEXICON tiers franchises/events as distinctive and recurrent car-lines as broad (model_extractor.py:135-155); extractor only emits lexicon-resolvable series, and _tier_suffix / _SERIES_DEFAULT_TIER='broad' force any untagged tier to broad. Load-time assertions guarantee pipe/newline-free canonicals + tier consistency. Tests: TestExtractSeries (franchise/event/car-line/acronym paths), TestSeriesLexicon::test_default_tier_is_broad, test_unrecognized_tier_defaults_to_broad, test_theme_only_pair_is_broad. Note: Super Treasure Hunt / Red Line Club are tagged distinctive — consistent with the user-spec 'лимитированная серия' → distinctive definition.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC8 — no cars AND no theme → check skipped, article publishes; DB stores a non-empty (non-NULL) 4-key structure
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: extract_fingerprint on empty input returns the 4-key all-empty structure (not NULL) (model_extractor.py:540); gate short-circuits only when BOTH strict AND series are empty (news_bot.py:1158-1159) — re-gated from the old strict-only short-circuit so pop-culture (empty strict, non-empty series) still reaches the pair scan. Tests: test_both_empty_short_circuit_real_extraction (end-to-end real extraction), test_theme_only_pop_culture_not_short_circuited, test_empty_body_four_keys.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC9 — any extractor/compare failure → ERROR + rate-limited [E016], article still publishes (degraded mode)
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Whole gate wrapped in try/except in job() → logger.exception + is_dedup_degraded_rate_limited-gated alert_dedup_degraded ([E016]) + fp=None → article publishes (news_bot.py:2294-2384). Tests: test_degraded_mode (extractor raises → publishes + [E016]), admin test_e016_dedup_degraded. Security audit (Task 8) confirmed the handler logs a full traceback (no silent swallow).

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: AC10 — backfill_fingerprints.py --days 30 re-fills pairs AND base car-fingerprint (widened re-select on missing $.pairs, not only IS NULL); idempotent; 30-day window; deploy runbook includes the pre-deploy SELECT COUNT check
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Widened SELECT: 'model_fingerprint IS NULL OR $.pairs missing', guarded by CASE WHEN json_valid(...) (backfill_fingerprints.py:297-302); skip-guard _already_backfilled requires the pairs key. Isolated temp-DB smoke: scanned exactly 1 row (in-window 2-key row missing $.pairs), skipped the 4-key row, excluded a 40-day-old row → widened re-select + 30-day window confirmed at the SQL level. Idempotency: second-run no-op. Runbook: deployment.md:222/233 documents the pre-deploy 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM published_articles WHERE model_fingerprint IS NOT NULL' + dark-deploy sequence. Tests: 19 in test_backfill_fingerprints.py (idempotency, widened re-select, corrupt-blob-safe, 30-day window, --days clamp). LIVE prod pre-check + prod backfill are operator-applied → see deferredToPostDeploy.

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Harness _pair_tier_verdict runs the REAL extract_fingerprint + shares_pair over the 8-pair fixture (not mocked). test_calibration_pair_tier_accuracy asserts ≥7/8; test_calibration_sdcc_dupes_hard_block asserts the 3 SDCC dupes any_distinctive is True (guarded against an empty selection); test_calibration_not_dupes_never_hard_block asserts every non-distinctive pair (across BOTH lists, incl. the broad Car Culture dupe pair-1) any_distinctive is False. findings.title: Accepted limitation: exact-key pair matching misses a dupe when only one side names a concrete model
findings.expected: Two articles about the same casting+franchise always share a pair key
findings.actual: If article A emits 'porsche 911|k-pop demon hunters|D' but article B (no model extracted) emits only the theme-only key '*|k-pop demon hunters|B', the keys differ → no shared pair → both publish. This is a false-NEGATIVE (safe direction: publish rather than silent block) and is documented + pinned by test_model_token_exact_match_limitation_documented. Mitigated by lexicon top-up via PR (user-spec Ограничения) and the 2-week channel spot-check. Not a blocker; no code change required for deploy.
findings.reproduction: Extract fingerprints for a titled-model article vs a theme-only article of the same franchise; shares_pair returns (False, [], False).

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: AC10 / Scenario 8 step 2 — pre-deploy cold-DB check on Moscow prod
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: Requires SSH + live prod DB (Claude cannot SSH prod); the base backfill was likely never run on the Moscow DB copied from the pre-feature NL snapshot (user-spec Risk 3).
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: Operator has SSH access to the Moscow prod host BEFORE rebuilding the container.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationSteps: Run: sqlite3 /root/hw-news/data/news.db "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM published_articles WHERE model_fingerprint IS NOT NULL". Expect ~0 / no-such-column (cold base). Record the number for comparison against the post-backfill re-count.

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: AC10 / Scenario 8 step 3 — prod backfill --days 30 + re-count > 0
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: Backfill must run against the live prod DB after the dark deploy; not reproducible pre-deploy. Tooling (widened re-select, 30-day window, idempotency) is verified by unit tests + the isolated temp-DB smoke.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: Container rebuilt on the Moscow host with DEDUP_SERIES_ENABLED=0 (dark deploy), OUTSIDE the 10:00–20:00 МСК publish window; DB_FILE points at the real prod DB.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationSteps: Run: python3 backfill_fingerprints.py --days 30 (per deployment.md runbook). Then re-run the SELECT COUNT from step 2 and confirm it is now > 0 (base car-fingerprint AND pairs warmed for the 30-day window). Confirm the summary logs Processed > 0, Errors == 0.

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: AC11 / user-spec 'Пользователь проверяет' — 2-week @myhwchannel live spot-check of [E015]/[E014]
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: Needs the live Telegram channel and ~2 weeks of real feed traffic through the enabled pair rule; no pre-deploy substitute (E2E is replaced by this monitoring per tech-spec).
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: After the observation window, toggle DEDUP_SERIES_ENABLED=1 and restart (outside the МСК window); the bot has processed real SDCC/franchise items.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationSteps: For 2 weeks watch @myhwchannel: (a) hard-block [E015] pings — confirm 0 visible model+series repeats in the channel and ≤1 false block/month; (b) broad [E014] pings — confirm they correspond to real theme dupes (published-with-flag is the intended tiering trade-off). If false hard blocks are frequent OR [E014] is noisy, flip the toggle off and top up the lexicon.
